title: Sequencing: warehouse upgrades
bodyMd:
Five warehouse upgrades are performed in five successive periods. Each upgrade occurs exactly once.

Positions are numbered 1 to 5 in order. The items are Doors, Lighting, Racks, Sensors, Ventilation.

- Lighting must occur after Sensors and before Ventilation.
- Doors and Racks must not occupy consecutive positions.
- Racks must occupy position 1 or position 4.
